data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the Scanbot Barcode Scanner SDK supporting 1D and 2D barcodes.
data.what_it_does: Provides scanning functionality for 1D and 2D barcodes like EAN, UPC, QR code, Data Matrix, and PDF 417. It operates entirely offline and includes ready-to-use UI components with single scanning, multi scanning, and Find & Pick modes.
use_when: You need reliable, high-performance barcode scanning that works offline.
You require ready-to-use UI components with AR overlays and barcode filters.
You need to parse structured information from 2D barcodes like boarding passes or IDs.
avoid_when: You are looking for a free or open-source barcode scanning solution, as this relies on the commercial Scanbot SDK.
You only need basic, lightweight QR code rendering rather than advanced scanning.
strengths: Fast barcode detection even in poor lighting or with damaged codes.
Comprehensive support for numerous 1D, 2D, and postal barcode symbologies.
Built-in Ready-to-Use UI with multiple scanning modes and AR overlays.
weaknesses: Requires a commercial license key for production use after the initial 60-second trial session.
License verification and native dependencies add integration overhead.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding platform-specific camera permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and Info.plist, and initializing the SDK with a license key.

alternatives.name: mobile_scanner
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick mobile_scanner if you need a free, open-source barcode and QR code scanner plugin.

alternatives.name: google_mlkit_barcode_scanning
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick google_mlkit_barcode_scanning if you prefer Google's ML Kit for on-device barcode detection.
